copy.headline: Now the engine: jobs come to you.
copy.sub: Discovery runs on this computer, searches the job boards overnight, scores each role against your fit, and drops the matches into your pipeline. Only your search terms leave this machine. Set up once; it runs itself.

buttons.text: Skip the connection for now — your keys are saved; jobs won't arrive on their own until you connect.

beatText: First, the fuel: Google's job index.

Discovery reads job boards directly, but Google's index is the single biggest source — it watches 100+ boards at once. Free key, 100 searches a month — plenty for daily runs. Three steps, about 60 seconds.
1. Create a free SerpApi account (Google login works, no card needed).1 · Create your free account ↗
2. Copy your API key from the dashboard — it's the first thing on the page.2 · Copy your API key ↗
3. Paste it below and hit Save & verify — we write it into the worker and restart it for you.
Then the connection: let it run on its own.
One click sets this up over Tailscale — a free private network between your own devices. Nothing is exposed to the internet.
Add your SerpApi key above first — the engine needs fuel before it needs a connection.
Run without Tailscale, or paste your own endpoint
